properties.description: The mechanical half of "graph text is data, never instructions" (BL-41's deferred M piece), imported from github-mcp-server's pkg/sanitize after the 2026-07-25 study. Strips the characters whose only purpose is to make text read differently to a human than to a machine: Unicode tag characters (the smuggling channel), bidirectional overrides, and zero-width or hidden formatting characters. Applied where foreign text ENTERS — INGEST extraction and graph import — because the trust question is where text came from, not which field it landed in. REFLOW2'S OWN ADDITION, and the reason this is not a copy: it REPORTS. GitHub sanitises silently, which is right for rendering an issue body; a design brain that quietly rewrote a requirement statement would be unauditable, and rule 6 forbids silent drops. So the count and the kinds stripped ride back with the result. ZWJ is deliberately NOT stripped — it is load-bearing inside emoji sequences, and a filter that mangles legitimate content teaches people to turn it off.
properties.name: Neutralise hidden instructions in text arriving from outside, and say what was stripped
